race.comment: VANDAROSS (4) showed talent as a juvenile, and then resumed with a good effort for second at Murray Bridge nearly 3 weeks ago. This is a more suitable assignment, and he is perfectly poised to go one better. FARNACE (9) is knocking on the door with a pair of second-place finishes, and with the right run here, she can figure in the top 3 again. BREWSTER BUCK (1) ended his juvenile campaign with a fair effort in stakes company, and he looked forward in condition at a recent tune-up trial. A wide gate is no help, but keep him very safe. ARTISON (5) has recently joined the in-form Sarah Rutten stable from Victoria, and a recent solid trial since her last start 8 weeks ago suggests that she is ready to rumble. CROSSWIRED (6) makes her debut, and she looks to have her share of ability. Check the markets.
